setup.run: npm install --no-audit && npm --prefix backend install --no-audit && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit && npm --prefix testing install --no-audit

property.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/property/ --reporter=default

idempotency.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/idempotency/ --reporter=default

chaos.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/chaos/ --reporter=default

contracts.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/contracts/ --reporter=default

perf.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/perf/ --reporter=default

typecheck.run: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc -b

services.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/ --reporter=default

security.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/container-security.test.ts ../testing/services/rbac-security.test.ts --reporter=default

resilience.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/network-resilience.test.ts ../testing/services/redis-cluster-failures.test.ts --reporter=default

timelapse.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/timelapseEngine.test.ts ../testing/services/timelapse.test.ts --reporter=default

integration.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/integration/ --reporter=default

frontend.run: cd frontend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/frontend/ --reporter=default

auth.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/auth/ --reporter=default

ws.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/ws/ --reporter=default

snapshot.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/snapshot/ --reporter=default

migration.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/migration/ --reporter=default

rate-limiting.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/rate-limiting/ --reporter=default

crdt-stress.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/crdt-stress/ --reporter=default

pty-stress.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/pty-stress/ --reporter=default

rbac-matrix.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/rbac-matrix/ --reporter=default

collab.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/collab/ --reporter=default

lsp.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/lsp/ --reporter=default
